scope: Certificate proposals only: exact saved-matrix replay does not replace canonical Lean enclosure, coverage, range, polynomial, anchor or native verification. No cap, capPad, refined-cover or endpoint change; non-centre pieces retain their original stored proposals.
source_semantics: Do not relabel frozen research as canonical. Later CI recomputes each proposed native certificate against current mathematical source.
